findings.summary: RFC3986 path-segment encoding is reimplemented in this resolver instead of using one shared route-encoding policy.
findings.consequence: Future route-encoding policy changes can drift between the shorthand resolver, adjacent source-info resolver, app navigation helpers, and server manifest clients; the copies already differ slightly in regex flags and lone-surrogate handling assumptions.
findings.evidence: The owned unit defines a local encodeRfc3986Segment at lines 11-16, while the same route segment encoder exists in app/lib/internal-navigation.ts, server/api/reader/resolve/[author]/[title].get.ts, server/utils/work-manifest-client.ts, and server/utils/reader-source.ts. The adjacent source-info resolver builds the same ReaderRouteResolution canonical path using its own copy.
findings.recommendation: Move the RFC3986 segment encoder to a shared app/server-safe utility and import it here and in the adjacent resolver, preserving existing manifest validation before encoding backend-sourced identities.
